purpose: Establish and preserve Sarallel likeness from real-photo geometry and real expression behavior. Sarah Likeness Master B is the strongest current derived likeness calibration base, while real photos remain supreme for geometry and facial-surface truth. Existing Sarallel fantasy iterations are design-only and have zero facial-geometry authority.

approvedDerivedMaster.name: Sarah Likeness Master B
approvedDerivedMaster.presentation: derived portrait calibration; hair-down Sarallel presentation remains separately locked

primaryGeometrySources.reason: exposes the face perimeter most clearly for cheek width, jaw transition, chin, eye spacing, nose family and mouth geometry

primaryGeometrySources.role: secondary facial-geometry confirmation plus primary Sarallel presentation authority
primaryGeometrySources.reason: confirms Sarah-specific geometry while preserving the preferred hair-down framing

derivedCalibrationSource.role: strongest current derived likeness base for the next HeroCel transition
derivedCalibrationSource.rule: Master B may summarize likeness geometry but may never overrule real photos for facial crease, dimple, under-eye line, fine texture, or age-signaling surface detail.

appearancePriority.secondary: Sarah Likeness Master B for derived identity calibration
appearancePriority.rule: Pulled-back hair may clarify facial geometry but may not silently become the default Sarallel appearance.

allowedUse: jaw movement from neutral to smile
forbiddenUse: skin color calibration from poor lighting

mayContribute: blue arcane geometry and interface-like magic

lockedAnchors: shorter rounder overall facial silhouette rather than elongated oval
rounded chin rather than pointed chin
natural adult eye scale and spacing
eyes not enlarged or dramatically upturned for fantasy stylization
broader softer nose family including base and tip
warm broad smile with natural cheek lift
adult age read consistent with real reference
hair-down face framing as primary Sarallel appearance
surfaceTruthOverrides: do not invent or deepen dimples absent from the real references
do not invent or deepen nasolabial crease lines absent from the real references
do not invent cheek crease marks as animation shorthand
do not invent under-eye crease lines as animation shorthand
do not use cel-shadow boundaries to imply older age than the real references
geometryOwned: nose width, bridge, base, tip, and placement

expressionAuthority.neutral: open, approachable, natural adult expression without generic fantasy-model severity
expressionAuthority.signatureSmile: wide warm smile with natural cheek lift and mild eye compression; no invented dimples or carved smile creases
expressionAuthority.rule: Expression may animate the locked face geometry but may not replace it with glamorized fantasy-heroine geometry or add age-signaling facial marks.

hardReject: legacy Sarallel iteration face used as likeness authority
age drift caused by invented facial lines
invented nasolabial or cheek crease lines
hair-up substitution as default Sarallel presentation
hairline or face-framing redesign that weakens Sarah recognition

productionProgression.likenessMaster: Sarah Likeness Master B locked as current derived calibration base
productionProgression.currentStage: likeness-only HeroCel animation transition before Sarallel design reintroduction
